name: polleria-las-delicias
description: Sistema de Pedidos - Arquitectura de Microservicios

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:products" "npm run start:orders"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:products" "npm run dev:orders" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:gateway && npm run install:auth && npm run install:products && npm run install:orders && npm run install:frontend
